# T-1: Stream final-regression execution

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Provide a live final-regression execution path that can emit elapsed-time heartbeat output while preserving the existing process result shape.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The production heartbeat cadence is 30000 ms.
- The timer stops when the child process exits, times out, or reports a spawn error.
- The process result fields consumed by run-final-regression remain started, exitCode, signal, timedOut, spawnError, stdout, and stderr.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer a final-regression-specific helper or a compatible extension of runProcessDetailed. Do not change regression command discovery or user-facing CLI arguments.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests use an internal short interval to observe two heartbeat events without waiting 60 seconds; production constant remains asserted as 30000 ms.
